rules:
Conservative merges of the test predictions, V6 as the base (best leaderboard score, 0.988109).

Rules fixed from the label-free agreement structure (agreement.json, disputed.json), never from test labels:
  M1 consensus_add   V6 + LORA-only pairs where V6's list for that S1 is a subset of LORA's (no conflict), the record
                     is not given to any other S1 by V6, and >= 4 of the 6 other systems (V3-noGNN, V4, V3, V2, C2v1,
                     C1) also predict it (so >= 6 of 8 systems agree). S1 that V6 leaves empty stay empty.
  M2 consensus_trim  M1 minus V6-only pairs that NO other system predicts (not LORA, not any of the 6), only where the
                     S1 keeps at least one other match (a predicted-empty S1 is never created by trimming)
  M3 france_lora     V6 for US / India, LORA for France (a probe: V6 and LORA differ most in France)
  M4 m1_france_lora  M1 for US / India, LORA for France
Every S1 of test_source1 appears once in the original order, IDs deduplicated, no record in two S1.
Precision / recall / F0.5 can't be computed on test (no labels): the audit reports the agreement counts only.
